policy: Only rows whose every clause was exercised on this build are promoted. Earlier builds' evidence is not relabelled as this build; F010's earlier promotion is re-proven here because 8093816c90 changed the client summary.

clientIntegration:F003.justification: Every clause exercised on build-1793021045283: absent: pass: a never-set-up client (Emerald City) offers setup to the manager; single: pass: White Rabbit Active, seats, Manage access; multiple: pass: two live relationships on one client (SQL fixture) show 'Multiple co-managed relationships'; no management controls until an explicit choice; choosing resolves the exact relationship; ended: pass: Kansas Farms 'Relationship ended' with history and no setup; inconsistent: pass after 8093816c90: a setup whose relationship names another client (SQL fixture) reads 'Co-managed record needs attention' with neither setup nor management, and is not adopted by the other client; forbidden: pass after 8093816c90: an Oz Technician sees the permission message on /msp/co-management, no client-tab writes, and the shared ticket fails closed; exact expected relationship identity for writes: pass: a stale second-tab staff-access save is refused with the revision unchanged; a URL carrying another relationship id fails closed. Multiple and inconsistent states require reversible SQL fixtures because the product offers no path that creates them; disclosed in the scenario limitations.

clientIntegration:F010.justification: Every clause exercised on build-1793021045283: absent offers Enable to an authorized manager only: pass: manager sees setup on an absent client; the Technician viewer is never offered Enable (no summary rendered); active shows seat usage and Manage: pass; ended shows end date and View history: pass (Kansas Farms); shared refresh between summary and client view: pass: seats 1 -> 2 -> 1 updated the summary in the same document (performance.timeOrigin unchanged)

clientIntegration:T009.justification: Every clause exercised on build-1793021045283: reserved progress then pending acceptance: pass: reserved seat and progress, then awaiting acceptance; reopens the original operation after failure/reload: pass: after reload the same operation shows delivery failure with Retry; distinguishes invitation expiry from delivery failure: pass: 'Invitation delivery failed; retry to send it.' vs 'Invitation expired' + 'Resend administrator invitation' (expiry via recorded time fixture); refreshes summary/usage after allocation or recovery: pass: recovery cleared the failure in the same document; allocation refresh in 06; active settings use embeddable sections: pass: White Rabbit tab embeds staff access, SLA link, capacity (06); ended state uses retained history: pass: Kansas Farms (06). Invitation expiry was produced by moving expires_at into the past; delivery failure used the local SMTP sink reject-mail fault. A reviewer may hold this row on the time fixture.

T13.justification: Progress on build-1793021045283: This build: MSP commercial time on a shared ticket and native ticket time bill together through native Automatic Invoices at the contract rate; approved time dated in an already-invoiced period bills once on the next invoice with its service period named, INV-000003 untouched, no double billing on retry; a qualified MSP ticket edit is attributed 'QA Tester (Oz)' in the customer audit and history. Remaining: MSP edit of a time entry itself; catalog-priced time with a real catalog price; customer operational time on this build.

T09.justification: Progress on build-1793021045283: This build: requester portal shows only requester-audience comments with matching counts; portal search, MSP full search and palette typeahead never surface hidden markers (positive controls live); customer portable export contains customer markers and no MSP-private notes. Remaining: Task conversation audiences: requester task access, task disclosure, task notifications/email on this build.

clientIntegration:F015.justification: Progress on build-1793021045283: Progress, delivery failure, durable automatic redelivery, expired invitation with Resend, and cancellation releasing the seat on this build. Remaining: worker failure and acknowledged cleanup.

T18.justification: Progress on build-1793021045283: Closure with participation and a retried closure produced exactly one closure, one sealed manifest, one archive file with no duplicates; MSP archive lists the ticket once; portable export excludes MSP-private notes. Remaining: Restore of the portable export needs an isolated destination installation (external).
